authority: No host/domain ownership or redirect behavior proven
required_redirect_behavior: stable public path never points to branch-only content
server-side 302/307 for movable targets; 301/308 only for permanent route policy
target version metadata and change history
no open redirect: allowlisted target origins only
no silent auto-advance to unverified revisions
health checks from outside host with rollback, expiry and owner
version snapshot permalink and independently checked readback

best_face_candidate.meaning: CoBestFace+: select the best independently qualified, audience-appropriate, source-anchored view; never replace evidence with polish

validation_targets.human_15s: Visitor can state purpose and actual maturity without a glossary
validation_targets.human_60s: Visitor can try a real working bounded capability or read a clearly marked source demonstration
validation_targets.machine: Consumer can retrieve structured currentness, provenance, capability boundaries and exact evidence sources
validation_targets.operator: No focus theft; one quiet truthful status and reversible next action
validation_targets.release: Source tested, independent receiver readproof, accessibility and privacy gates before promotion
